short_description: Departure gate B12, used for short and medium haul flights.
directions: From main check-in hall, follow signs to Pier B, take escalator to Level 2, gate is on the left after security.
accessibility: Step-free access, wheelchair ramp available, accessible seating near gate desk.
related_facilities: Restroom Block A, Vending machines, Gate B10-B14
emergency_or_help_contact: Gate agent desk / Airport info line +49-30-000-1111

short_description: Main check-in counters for international and domestic flights departing from Terminal 1.
directions: Enter Terminal 1 main hall, check-in counters are directly ahead, organized by airline alliance.
accessibility: Priority check-in lane for reduced-mobility passengers, low-height counters available.
related_facilities: Baggage drop, Ticketing office, Currency exchange

short_description: Central baggage claim hall with carousels 1 to 8 for arriving flights.
directions: Follow 'Baggage Claim' signs after passport control, carousels are numbered and matched to flight number on arrival screens.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible, baggage trolleys available, lowered carousel viewing area.
related_facilities: Lost and Found, Customs desk, Trolley rental

short_description: Central security screening checkpoint for all departing passengers.
directions: After check-in, follow overhead signs to 'Security Control', multiple lanes including fast-track for premium passengers.
accessibility: Dedicated accessible lane, staff assistance available for passengers with disabilities.
related_facilities: Fast-track lane, Liquids repacking station, Duty free zone beyond security

short_description: General passenger information and wayfinding assistance desk.
directions: Located in the center of the main terminal hall, opposite the check-in counters.
accessibility: Fully wheelchair accessible, hearing loop available, multilingual staff.
related_facilities: Lost and Found, Special Assistance Desk, Currency exchange

short_description: Office for reporting and retrieving lost items and mishandled baggage.
directions: Adjacent to Baggage Claim Hall, next to Carousel 1, clearly signed 'Lost and Found'.
accessibility: Step-free access, counter at wheelchair-accessible height.
related_facilities: Baggage Claim Hall, Customs desk

short_description: Premium passenger lounge with seating, food, and Wi-Fi, near gates C1-C10.
directions: After security, take escalator to Level 3, lounge entrance is opposite Gate C3.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible entrance, accessible restrooms inside lounge.
related_facilities: Business center, Shower facilities, Quiet zone

short_description: Quiet multi-faith prayer and reflection room for passengers.
directions: From main hall, follow signs to Gate A5, prayer room is on the right before the gate.
accessibility: Step-free access, prayer mats and ablution facilities available.
related_facilities: Restroom Block A, Family Room

short_description: Food court with international and local dining options after security.
directions: Take escalator up after security screening, restaurant court is straight ahead on Level 2.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible seating and counters, accessible restrooms nearby.
related_facilities: Duty free shops, Lounge, Restrooms

short_description: Direct rail link connecting the airport to the city center and regional trains.
directions: Follow 'Train Station' signs from arrivals hall, take elevator or escalator down to basement level.
accessibility: Elevators available, tactile guidance paths, accessible ticket machines.
related_facilities: Ticket office, Taxi Pickup Zone, Car rental counter

short_description: Designated taxi pickup point directly outside the arrivals hall.
directions: Exit through the main arrivals doors, taxi zone is marked with yellow signage to the right.
accessibility: Step-free curb access, accessible taxi vehicles available on request.
related_facilities: Shuttle Bus Stop, Car Rental Counter

short_description: Dedicated desk for passengers needing mobility, visual, hearing, or cognitive assistance.
directions: Located near the main entrance, marked with the international accessibility symbol.
accessibility: Fully accessible desk, wheelchair loan service, staff trained in assistance procedures.
related_facilities: Information Desk, Security fast-track lane

short_description: Public restroom facility with standard and accessible stalls.
directions: Located next to the Prayer Room near Gate A5.
accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible stall, baby changing station, emergency call button.
related_facilities: Prayer Room, Family Room

short_description: Family-friendly space with baby changing facilities and a small play area.
directions: Adjacent to Restroom Block A near Gate A5.
accessibility: Step-free access, low changing tables, accessible seating.
related_facilities: Restroom Block A, Prayer Room

short_description: Airport pharmacy offering over-the-counter medication and travel health items.
directions: Located near the Information Desk in the main terminal hall.
accessibility: Step-free access, wheelchair-accessible counter.
related_facilities: Information Desk, Medical Assistance Point

short_description: Cluster of bank ATMs and a currency exchange kiosk.
directions: Next to the Information Desk in the main terminal hall.
accessibility: Step-free access, ATM screens with audio guidance for visually impaired users.
related_facilities: Information Desk, Pharmacy

short_description: Passport control and immigration checkpoint for arriving international passengers.
directions: Follow 'Passport Control' signs immediately after leaving the aircraft, before baggage claim.
accessibility: Dedicated accessible counters, staff assistance for reduced-mobility passengers.
related_facilities: Baggage Claim Hall, Customs desk

short_description: Shuttle bus stop connecting terminals and long-term parking areas.
directions: Exit arrivals hall and turn right, shuttle stop is marked with a blue bus sign.
accessibility: Low-floor buses with wheelchair ramps, audio stop announcements.
related_facilities: Taxi Pickup Zone, Car Rental Counter

short_description: Multiple car rental company counters for arriving passengers.
directions: Located in the arrivals hall, opposite the Taxi Pickup Zone exit.
accessibility: Step-free access, accessible vehicles available on request.
related_facilities: Taxi Pickup Zone, Shuttle Bus Stop

short_description: First-aid and medical assistance point staffed by trained personnel.
directions: Located near the Pharmacy in the main terminal hall, marked with a red cross sign.
accessibility: Fully wheelchair accessible, emergency stretcher access.
related_facilities: Pharmacy, Information Desk
